description:
Independent verification confirmed two low-risk cleanup items in the
visualization subsystem:

  - `benchbox/core/visualization/result_plotter.py` imports `re` inside
    `_sort_results_by_version()` and `_natural_sort_key()`, while
    `ascii_runtime.py` already imports `re` at module top.

    natural query-ID sort key.

The original review overstated one detail: `statistics` is already imported
at module top in `ascii_runtime.py`, so there is no per-call `statistics`
import to fix. This TODO keeps the cleanup narrow and intentionally separate
from the registry/orchestration refactors.
